_comment: GEPA TRAINING SPLIT. Authored independently of locomo-mini.json, which is the held-out evaluation set. Optimisation runs must use this file; locomo-mini.json is only ever scored, never tuned on. Conversations deliberately vary phrasing, entity density, and the position of the answer-bearing turn so a policy fitted here is not fitted to one wording.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: I accepted the offer at Datadog. Starting February 2nd.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Congrats! Are you moving?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Yes, relocating from Austin to Boston for it.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: What team?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Observability infrastructure. Reporting to a manager named Devi.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Signed a lease in Somerville, not downtown like I planned.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: How much?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: $3200 a month, which is brutal compared to Austin.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Worth it?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: The commute is 20 minutes so yes.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Two weeks in. The onboarding was rough but the team is great.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Still on observability?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: They moved me to the storage team in week one. Long story.

turns.speaker: Theo
turns.text: We're opening the restaurant on March 15th.

turns.speaker: Ida
turns.text: What's it called?

turns.speaker: Theo
turns.text: Calling it Ember. Wood-fired everything.

turns.speaker: Ida
turns.text: Where?

turns.speaker: Theo
turns.text: On Valencia Street, the old bakery space.

turns.speaker: Theo
turns.text: Hired a head chef. Her name is Rosa, she came from Quince.

turns.speaker: Ida
turns.text: Nice pedigree. Menu size?

turns.speaker: Theo
turns.text: Twelve dishes to start. I wanted twenty but Rosa talked me down.

turns.speaker: Theo
turns.text: We opened three days late, on the 18th. Permit delay.

turns.speaker: Ida
turns.text: How was night one?

turns.speaker: Theo
turns.text: Ninety covers. Way past what we projected.

turns.speaker: Nadia
turns.text: My thesis defence is scheduled for June 4th.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: On what exactly?

turns.speaker: Nadia
turns.text: Sparse attention for long-context retrieval.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: Who's on your committee?

turns.speaker: Nadia
turns.text: Chaired by Professor Lindqvist, plus two externals.

turns.speaker: Nadia
turns.text: Chapter four got rejected by my advisor. Rewriting the whole evaluation.

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: Ouch. Does that push the defence?

turns.speaker: Nadia
turns.text: Moved it to July 9th to be safe.

turns.speaker: Nadia
turns.text: Passed with minor revisions!

turns.speaker: Omar
turns.text: Amazing. How long was it?

turns.speaker: Nadia
turns.text: Two hours and ten minutes of questions.

turns.speaker: Raj
turns.text: Registered for the Dolomites gran fondo in September.

turns.speaker: Pia
turns.text: Distance?

turns.speaker: Raj
turns.text: 138 kilometres with 4000 metres of climbing.

turns.speaker: Pia
turns.text: Target?

turns.speaker: Raj
turns.text: I'd like to go under seven hours.

turns.speaker: Raj
turns.text: Cracked a rib in a crash at the Tuesday crit.

turns.speaker: Pia
turns.text: Are you out?

turns.speaker: Raj
turns.text: Six weeks off the bike. The fondo is still on though.

turns.speaker: Raj
turns.text: Finished in 7:22:05. Missed the target but I'll take it.

turns.speaker: Pia
turns.text: After a broken rib that's strong.

turns.speaker: Raj
turns.text: Bike held up too. The new Campagnolo groupset was worth it.

turns.speaker: Ines
turns.text: We got an inbound from Cloudflare about acquiring us.

turns.speaker: Gus
turns.text: Number?

turns.speaker: Ines
turns.text: They floated $40M, all stock.

turns.speaker: Gus
turns.text: Would you take it?

turns.speaker: Ines
turns.text: Not at that price. We just closed our Series A.

turns.speaker: Ines
turns.text: They came back at $65M with half cash.

turns.speaker: Gus
turns.text: That's a real move.

turns.speaker: Ines
turns.text: Board meets Thursday to vote on it.

turns.speaker: Ines
turns.text: We signed. $65M, closing in August.

turns.speaker: Gus
turns.text: What happens to the team?

turns.speaker: Ines
turns.text: Everyone gets offers. I'm staying on for two years.
